title: Thanh Van Mon Episode 15: The Corrupted Butterfly
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, cultivation/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy dark corruption arcs and the tragedy of a once-beautiful kingdom falling
tone: Dark corruption, terror emerging, beauty defiled, horror and grief

concept.hook: The Silver Gate — the gate she could not open — had opened itself. Something was coming through. Something that used to be beautiful.
concept.story_arc: Silver Gate cracks open by itself → A corrupted butterfly spirit emerges → Black veins on once-luminous wings → The corruption spreads → Kingdom in panic
concept.emotion: Dread → Shock → Horror → Panic → Desperate protection

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the Silver Butterfly Gate — a massive mirror of liquid silver in the cavern wall — begins to ripple. Then crack. Silver light turns dark. The entire kingdom feels it — a tremor. Residents look up. Children clutch parents. Something is pushing through from the other side. Camera: wide shot — Silver Gate cracking, silver turning dark, entire kingdom noticing, terror beginning. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide shot — Silver Gate cracking open by itself, silver turning dark, entire kingdom feeling it, 6s
shots.narration: The Silver Gate — which only opened for the pure of heart — was forcing itself open.
shots.sfx: Gate cracking, silver darkening, kingdom trembling, residents looking up, children crying

shots.prompt: Medium shot — a butterfly spirit pushes through the cracked gate. Beautiful once — luminous silver wings, graceful form. Now — black veins cover every wing. The silver is gray, cracked, rotting. Its eyes — once kind — are now pits of void darkness. It looks at the kingdom. Screams — a sound no butterfly spirit should make. Camera: medium — corrupted butterfly spirit emerging, beautiful wings now black-veined and rotting, void eyes, terrible scream. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium — corrupted butterfly spirit emerging, beautiful wings now black-veined and rotting, void eyes, 6s
shots.narration: A butterfly spirit — corrupted. Its beauty — turned to poison.
shots.sfx: Corrupted wing movement, void eyes, terrible scream, gate cracking further, residents screaming

shots.prompt: Close-up — the corrupted butterfly flies over the kingdom. Where its shadow passes — flowers wilt. Crystal buildings crack. Butterfly-winged residents fall — unconscious, drained. Its black-veined wings spread wider — and the corruption spreads faster. The Queen screams: 'SHELTER! GET THE CHILDREN TO SHELTER!' Camera: close-up — shadow causing flowers to wilt, buildings cracking, residents falling, queen's desperate command. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — shadow causing destruction, flowers wilting, buildings cracking, residents falling, queen commanding shelter, 6s
shots.narration: Its shadow alone — was killing the kingdom. Flower by flower. Crystal by crystal.
shots.sfx: Corruption spreading, flowers wilting, crystal cracking, residents screaming, queen's command

shots.prompt: Medium close-up — our protagonist runs through panicked crowds toward the Silver Gate. Her butterfly mark is burning. The jade butterfly in her robes is SCREAMING — a high-pitched warning she can barely hear over the chaos. She sees the corrupted spirit — and freezes. She knows that butterfly. Camera: medium — running through panicked crowds, mark burning, jade screaming, seeing the corrupted spirit and freezing. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium — running through crowds, mark burning, jade screaming, freezing at sight of corrupted spirit, 6s
shots.narration: She recognized the corrupted butterfly. And that recognition — terrified her more than the corruption itself.
shots.sfx: Crowds screaming, running footsteps, mark burning, jade butterfly screaming, her sharp gasp

shots.prompt: Close-up extreme — the corrupted butterfly turns. Sees our protagonist. Its void eyes widen. It SPEAKS — in a broken, corrupted voice: 'Sister.' She falls to her knees. The corrupted butterfly was her companion. Her friend. The butterfly that guided her through the butterfly realm. Now — twisted. Ruined. And it still knew her face. Camera: extreme close-up — void eyes speaking 'sister,' her falling to knees, grief and horror. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up — corrupted spirit speaking 'sister,' her falling to knees, grief and horror, 6s
shots.narration: The corruption had taken someone she loved. And it still wore her friend's voice.
shots.sfx: Corrupted voice speaking, her knees hitting ground, crowd screaming in background, jade wailing
